wheel_metadata_license.scope: NVIDIA distribution license metadata for the selected binary wheel; not the same material as the source project LICENSE.txt.

selected_wheel_notice.scope: This 1,895-byte BSD notice says the code also includes files from NVIDIA Tools Extension SDK and points to NVTX. It is an embedded third-party notice; it is not the binary distribution license text.

binary_distribution_license.document_release: NCCL 2.29.7 documentation archive; SLA dated March 2026; includes NCCL Binary Supplement
binary_distribution_license.reviewed_terms_scope: The Binary Supplement allows the runtime files (.so, .h) to be redistributed solely in binary form as a component of the distributor's own application with additional material functionality, subject to the SLA, valid NVIDIA copyright notices, and downstream terms at least as restrictive. This is a bounded summary of the official text, not a statement that every operational requirement has been implemented.

scope_reconciliation: No conflict is inferred between the proprietary binary metadata and the selected BSD notice or source project notices: they identify different scopes. The wheel notice is the NVTX-related third-party text; the NCCL source LICENSE.txt and ThirdPartyNotices cover source/project notice scopes; the official SLA and NCCL Binary Supplement state the NVIDIA binary distribution terms.
